# Prescriptive lessons — dirk-laukens × jazz-guitar-chord-dictionary

35 notes across 13 chord_qualities — voicing-catalog reference. Key vocabulary: shell-voicing-floor, drop-2/3 system, inversion-comping-substitution, ensemble-register-tone-constraint, altered-dominant-scale-origin (Lydian dom vs altered scale separation), minor-ii-V-I-application, quartal/open as distinct voicing categories.

See `prescriptive-lessons-draft.json` for the structured payload covering: maj7, maj6, maj69, maj9, maj13, min7, min7b5, dom7, dom7b5, dom7alt, dom9#11, quartal, open.

Compact form to keep PR review surface manageable.
